name: web-grocery-product-page-hero-crop
title: Product Page with Large Package Tile
whatItIs: A full-width product page under a teal header: breadcrumb-style title, a big rounded tile showing a flour bag with a 'Free Delivery' tab, five thumbnails, a countdown, title, rating, superscript price, installment strip, add-to-cart and lime Buy now buttons, badges and delivery notes.
whatItMeans: Big imagery, a clear price and one bright button guide the user quickly to purchase, while small details support trust.
techniques: Corner tab badge on the image tile
Thumbnail strip beneath the main image
Price in bold with small raised decimals
Secondary neutral button next to the lime primary
Icon-led reassurance row at the bottom

vocabulary.definition: A label attached to the corner of an image.
A bright main button beside a muted alternative.
Icons and short lines that reassure about delivery or deals.
